type_dispute_reason: I hit a deer on the highway. The form flagged this as possibly an animal strike, but the car collided with the animal at speed so I consider it a collision claim.
narrative: At dusk on {location} a deer ran across the road and I could not avoid hitting it. The impact damaged the hood, grille and radiator support. A state trooper attended and wrote a report. I filed it as a collision claim.
